text_en: “Look, my eye has seen all this, my ear has heard and understood it.
text_cn: 的确，这一切我亲眼见过，亲耳听过，是我熟悉的事。

text_en: What you know, I also know; I am not inferior to you.
text_cn: 你们所知道的，我也知道，我并不亚于你们。

text_en: But I would speak to the Almighty, and I desire to argue my case with God.
text_cn: 但是，我愿同全能者交谈，愿与天主辩论，

text_en: As for you, you whitewash with lies; all of you are worthless physicians.
text_cn: 因为你们都是谎言的捏造者，全是无用的医生。

text_en: If you would only keep silent, that would be your wisdom!
text_cn: 恨不得你们闭口不言！这样才算聪明。

text_en: Hear now my reasoning, and listen to the pleadings of my lips.
text_cn: 请你们听我的怨诉，留意我口中的辩论！

text_en: Will you speak falsely for God, and speak deceitfully for him?
text_cn: 你们想以诡诈来为天主辩护，以谎言来为他说理？

text_en: Will you show partiality toward him, will you plead the case for God?
text_cn: 难道你们想偏袒天主，有意为他辩护吗？

text_en: Will it be well with you when he searches you out? Or can you deceive him, as one person deceives another?
text_cn: 他揭穿了你们，难道为你们有益？难道你们能欺骗他如人之欺骗人？

text_en: He will surely rebuke you if in secret you show partiality.
text_cn: 你们若假意偏袒，他必严厉斥责你们。

text_en: Will not his majesty terrify you, and the dread of him fall upon you?
text_cn: 他的尊严能不使你们恐怖？他的威吓能不落在你们身上？

text_en: Your maxims are proverbs of ashes, your defenses are defenses of clay.
text_cn: 你们的古谚都是些腐朽之谈，你们的答辩都是些泥制的盾牌。

text_en: “Let me have silence, and I will speak, and let come on me what may.
text_cn: 你们且住口，让我来发言：不要管我有什么遭遇。

text_en: I will take my flesh in my teeth, and put my life in my hand.
text_cn: 我已将我的肉放在我牙齿中，已将我的性命放在我手中；

text_en: See, he will kill me; I have no hope; but I will defend my ways to his face.
text_cn: 即使他杀我，我仍希望在他面前表白我的行为。

text_en: This will be my salvation, that the godless shall not come before him.
text_cn: 这样对我还有救，因为恶人不敢到他面前。

text_en: Listen carefully to my words, and let my declaration be in your ears.
text_cn: 你们要细听我的话，侧耳静听我的解释。

text_en: I have indeed prepared my case; I know that I shall be vindicated.
text_cn: 我今呈上我的案件，确知我自己有理。

text_en: Who is there that will contend with me? For then I would be silent and die.
text_cn: 谁若与我争辩，我就住口，情愿死去。

text_en: Only grant two things to me, then I will not hide myself from your face:
text_cn: 惟有二事，你切莫向我作，我就不回避你：

text_en: withdraw your hand far from me, and do not let dread of you terrify me.
text_cn: 请将你的手由我身上撤回，莫让你的威严恐吓我。

text_en: Then call, and I will answer; or let me speak, and you reply to me.
text_cn: 那时你若召唤，我必回答；或者我说，你回答我。

text_en: How many are my iniquities and my sins? Make me know my transgression and my sin.
text_cn: 我的邪恶罪过，究有多少？让我认识我的过犯和罪过。

text_en: Why do you hide your face, and count me as your enemy?
text_cn: 你为何遮掩你的面容，将我视作你的仇人？

text_en: Will you frighten a windblown leaf and pursue dry chaff?
text_cn: 难道你要喝走被风吹落的树叶，要追逐已枯干的碎秸？

text_en: For you write bitter things against me, and make me reap the iniquities of my youth.
text_cn: 你写下了我受苦的判词，使我承当我青年时的罪过。

text_en: You put my feet in the stocks, and watch all my paths; you set a bound to the soles of my feet.
text_cn: 你把我的脚缚在木桩上，窥察我的一切行动，又为我的脚步划定界限。

text_en: One wastes away like a rotten thing, like a garment that is moth-eaten.
text_cn: 我的生命已如腐烂的朽木，已如蛀蚀的衣服。
